name: Letterspaced capitals
summary: Capital letters set with wide space between them, so that a short word reads as an inscription of rank.
how: Track capitals at 0.1 to 0.3em; do not track lowercase.
Set the size small, at 11 to 14px on screen, in a light weight.
Use roman capitals with strong serifs or a clean geometric sans.
Keep the line to one to four words.

origin.note: Carvers cut the spaced roman capitals of the inscription on Trajan's Column.

adoptions.via: Badges of clubs, railways and makers set the name in spaced capitals round the ring.
Fashion and hotel houses set their names in spaced roman capitals.
Carol Twombly draws the Trajan typeface for Adobe from the column inscription.
Luxury sites set spaced small-cap labels over a large serif head.
